method: Real Three.js + unmodified Mission16 main.ts, scene, terrain, sky, calendar, weather and renderer. Explicit diagnostic single-tree isolation; only the inspected mesh changes. Paired camera/climate held between before and after. Fine M14 solar cache disabled for BOTH in-world variants to avoid applying stale crown shadows. No geographic anchor edited, no production forest replaced. 5m views intentionally crop large trees for near inspection; 15/40m show full form. Workshop uses original shared naturalSky and native walker.
